newsitem.title: UK: One Brent date kept, the other clocked - traders.
newsitem.headline: One Brent date kept, the other clocked - traders.

text.p: One of the Brent crude cargoes nominated from the paper chains on Wednesday was kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, while the other was clocked, traders said.
Shell UK kept one cargo loading Feb 13-15, and the other was clocked to U.S. refiner Tosco, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
